data.title: The History of the Bicycle
data.passage: The history of the bicycle is fascinating. Early versions were very different from what we see today. Initially, people used simple wheel {contraption|contraptions} that required great effort to move. These early models lacked pedals and required the rider to push with their feet. Later, inventors added pedals, creating a structure that was much {most efficient|more efficient}. By the late 19th century, the modern safety bicycle appeared, making cycling accessible to many people. It quickly became a popular form of transportation all {on|over} the world.

errors.explanation: Cümlede birden fazla cihazdan bahsedildiği için kelime çoğul formunda kalmalıdır.
Bu yapıda yalnızca iki nesne karşılaştırıldığı için "more" yapısı doğrudur.
Dünya gibi geniş bir alanı ifade etmek için "over" edatı kullanılmalıdır.

data.title: A Trip to the Science Museum
data.passage: The class visited the Natural History Museum last week. They found the exhibits regarding deep-sea life truly fascinating. Our guide explained how marine organisms {adapt on|adapt to} high-pressure environments. Students were eager to examine the skeletal structures of ancient dinosaurs. Furthermore, they learned about the {geology|geological} processes that formed mountain ranges. This outing {provide|provided} students with invaluable knowledge about Earth science.

errors.explanation: Bir ortama uyum sağlamak için 'adapt to' kalıbı kullanılır.
'Processes' (süreçler) kelimesini nitelemek için sıfat olan 'geological' gerekir.
Hikaye geçmişte yaşandığı için fiilin geçmiş zaman hali 'provided' olmalıdır.

data.title: Community Park Cleanup Project
data.passage: Last Saturday, we organized a significant cleanup project at Willow Creek Park. Our volunteers arrived early, {equipped to|equipped with} gloves and refuse bags. We spent the morning removing litter and trimming overgrown bushes. The commitment of the community {were|was} truly commendable. Although the work was physically demanding, the resulting improvements to the park’s ecosystem were noticeable. We collected several large amounts of recycling, proving that collective effort can {dramatic|dramatically} benefit the environment.

errors.explanation: Hazırlanma durumu belirtilirken 'with' edatı kullanılır, 'to' değil.
Özne tekil ('commitment') olduğu için fiil de tekil (was) olmalıdır.

data.title: Developing Culinary Proficiency
data.passage: Mastering culinary skills {require|requires} more than simply following a recipe. One must understand the underlying principles of flavor and texture. For instance, adapting traditional dishes necessitates {thorough grasp|a thorough grasp} of regional ingredients and preparation techniques. Consequently, cooking at home fosters self-sufficiency, allowing one to {adjusts|adjust} meals according to specific dietary needs. This practice not only saves {considerably|considerable} amounts of money but also significantly improves nutritional intake. Eventually, one develops a sophisticated repertoire of gourmet dishes.

errors.explanation: Özne 'Mastering' tekil bir eylemi belirttiği için fiil de tekil ('requires') olmalıdır.
'Grasp' (anlayış) gibi sayılabilen isimler bir belirtici artikel ('a') ile kullanılmalıdır.
‘Allowing one to’ yapısından sonra gelen ana fiilin yalın (base) formu kullanılır.
'Amounts' (miktar) bir isim olduğu için, onu niteleyen bir sıfat (adjective) gereklidir.
